Title: "Legacy of Power" and continue combat effects (like Psyche!)

Messages.Author: Hakuron
Messages.Body:
Hi,

since a lot of "continue combat effects/cards" questions have been asked lately, here is another one for clarity's sake:

Can a superior Psyche! (or something similar) be played in a combat that is ended by Legacy of Power?

> Name: Legacy of Power
> Cardtype: Reaction
> Cost: 3 blood
> Requires a ready prince, justicar or Inner Circle member.
> Only usable when another vampire you control enters combat. Lock this reacting vampire and end combat. Each of the vampires involved in that combat goes to torpor.
>
> Name: Psyche!
> Cardtype: Combat
> Discipline: Celerity
> [cel] Press.
> [CEL] Only usable at the end of a round when both combatants are still ready and combat is about to end. After this round, begin another combat with the opposing minion.
>
Thanks in advance!

Messages.Author: Arthur Volts
Messages.Body: Odd. How can a new combat start if both vampires are in torpor?

Messages.Author: Kraus
Messages.Body:
> Arthur wrote:
> Odd. How can a new combat start if both vampires are in torpor?
>
Correct me if I'm wrong, but:

The combat actually starts due to card text. If it said "would enter combat", they wouldn't.

In combat, combat cards can be played. Combat would end when both combatants leave the ready region. However, a queued new combat from Psyche interrupts the 'enter torpor' (or, leaving ready region) with the new combat that ensues. The game state forgets that either would've left the ready region, and commences the new combat instead.

Psyche is still pretty tricky, but many cases are covered in the Card Rulings on VEKN.

Of course, the more case specific examples are covered in the rulings, the better, as Psyche can be one of the trickier cards.

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> Hakuron wrote:
> Fair and square. But a lot of errata were released, why not adding a new erratum?
>
Typically, unless things are actually causing havoc or real problems, errata of that sort is often left until a reprint occurs. Other than being slightly weird - being a reaction card played inside combat - Legacy of Power isn't really causing any actual problems at present, because loads of effects end combat while in combat, so we know how to handle it.

Psyche! could cause a variety of of unpleasant weird side effects so it was fixed - but that also occurred at a point when no-one was sure if V:TES would ever see print ever again.
